problem: The note says 'req.params.id = 42', which shows the parameter as a number. The chapter itself states twice (Section 2 and worked example step 2) that route parameters are always strings. A student reading only the figure would learn the wrong type.
The list of methods reads as if get, post, put, patch and delete are the complete set. Express also exposes app.head, app.options, app.all and app.use, so a student may think only those five exist.
fix: Say 'The common methods are app.get, app.post, app.put, app.patch and app.delete; app.head, app.options and app.all also exist, where app.all matches every method.'
